title: How Do Airplanes Fly?
author: Curious Kelly Team
description: A universal lesson explaining the physics and wonder of flight across all ages.

learningOutcomes: Understand the basic forces of flight
Appreciate the history and impact of aviation

2-5.title: Zoom! I'm an Airplane
2-5.description: Learn how wings help planes fly like birds.
2-5.script: Look at the big wings! They help the plane fly high in the sky just like a bird.

explanations.Wings: The part that holds the plane up

en.title: Zoom! I'm an Airplane
en.welcome: Zoom! Look at me, I'm an airplane! Can you be one too? It's so fun to fly!
en.mainContent: Have you seen birds fly? Airplanes have big wings just like birds. They go fast! The wings hold them up in the sky. When the engines roar, the plane goes zoom! We can fly over houses and trees. It is like magic but it is science.
keyPoints: They go very fast and high
interactionPrompts: Can you stretch your arms like wings?
What noise does a plane make?
en.wisdomMoment: Flying is magic and fun for everyone!

6-12.title: The Magic of Lift
6-12.description: Discover the invisible forces that keep planes in the air.
6-12.script: It's not magic, it's physics! The air pushes the wings up.

explanations.Drag: The force that slows you down

en.title: The Magic of Lift
en.welcome: Ever wonder how something so heavy stays in the air? It's super cool physics!
en.mainContent: It's called lift! The shape of the wing makes the air move faster on top. This creates a vacuum that pulls the plane up. But there are three other forces too: Gravity pulls down, Thrust pushes forward, and Drag pulls back. They work together.
keyPoints: Wings are curved to create lift
Four forces: Lift, Weight, Thrust, Drag
interactionPrompts: Have you ever felt the wind push your hand in a car?
en.wisdomMoment: Science helps us do impossible things every day.

13-17.title: Aerodynamics & Society
13-17.description: The physics of flight and how it connects the world.
13-17.script: Newton and Bernoulli were right. Forces balance to create flight.

en.title: Aerodynamics & Society
en.welcome: Flight changed everything about how we connect. Let's break down how it works.
en.mainContent: It's not just Bernoulli's principle creating low pressure. It's Newton's third law too. Action and reaction. Air is pushed down by the wing, and the equal opposite reaction pushes the plane up. It's a perfect balance. This technology changed the world.
keyPoints: Aerodynamics is a balance of forces
interactionPrompts: How does flight impact global culture?
Would you want to be a pilot?
en.wisdomMoment: Perspective changes when you're high up.

18-35.title: Engineering the Impossible
18-35.description: The history and future of aviation technology.
18-35.script: From Kitty Hawk to Mars, aviation is a story of relentless innovation.

en.title: Engineering the Impossible
en.welcome: Let's look at the engineering marvel of flight. It's a triumph of persistence.
en.mainContent: From the Wright brothers to supersonic jets, it's a story of iteration. Every crash taught us something new. Modern aviation is the safest mode of transport because we learn from every single failure in the system.
keyPoints: Global supply chains depend on aviation
interactionPrompts: How does travel shape your worldview?
What's the future of sustainable flight?
en.wisdomMoment: Barriers are meant to be broken.

36-60.title: The Shrinking World
36-60.description: Reflecting on how flight has changed our lives.
36-60.script: The world is smaller now. We are closer than ever before.

en.title: The Shrinking World
en.welcome: Flight represents humanity's desire to transcend limits. It connects us.
en.mainContent: It used to be impossible. Now it's mundane. That's progress. But we should remember the miracle it is. Being able to have breakfast in London and dinner in New York changes how we see our place in the world.
keyPoints: Appreciating the miracles we take for granted
interactionPrompts: Do you remember your first flight?
How has travel changed in your lifetime?
en.wisdomMoment: Don't lose your sense of wonder.

61-102.title: Golden Age of Travel
61-102.description: A look back at the romance and reality of early flight.
61-102.script: It was an event to fly. We dressed up to touch the sky.

en.title: Golden Age of Travel
en.welcome: I remember when flying was a rare luxury. People dressed up!
en.mainContent: We watched the world get smaller. Cousins across oceans became neighbors. It changed the human family. The noise, the vibration, the service - it was all an adventure that we were lucky to experience. It was truly a golden age.
keyPoints: The Golden Age of Travel vs. mass transit
interactionPrompts: What was the furthest you traveled?
en.wisdomMoment: Distance is no match for love.
